basic.name: Ice-Breaking Light
basic.description_template: Deals Fire DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of the Trailblazer's ATK to a single enemy and gains 1 stack of Magma Will.

variants.name: Ice-Breaking Light
variants.description_template: Consumes 4 stacks of Magma Will to enhance Basic ATK, dealing Fire DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of the Trailblazer's ATK to a single enemy and Fire DMG to equal to {{scaling2}}% of the Trailblazer's ATK to enemies adjacent to it.

skill.name: Ever-Burning Amber
skill.description_template: Increases the Trailblazer's DMG Reduction by {{scaling1}}% and gains 1 stack of Magma Will, with a 100% base chance to Taunt all enemies for 1 turn(s).

ultimate.name: War-Flaming Lance
ultimate.description_template: Deals Fire DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of the Trailblazer's ATK plus {{scaling2}}% of the Trailblazer's DEF to all enemies. The next Basic ATK will be automatically enhanced and does not cost Magma Will.

talent.name: Treasure of the Architects
talent.description_template: Each time the Trailblazer is hit, they gain 1 stack of Magma Will for a max of 8 stack(s). When Magma Will has no fewer than 4 stacks, the Trailblazer's Basic ATK becomes enhanced, dealing DMG to a single enemy and enemies adjacent to it. When the Trailblazer uses Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate, apply a Shield to all allies that absorbs DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of the Trailblazer's DEF plus {{scaling2}}. The Shield lasts for 2 turn(s).

technique.name: Call of the Guardian
technique.description: After using Technique, at the start of the next battle, gains a Shield that absorbs DMG equal to 30% of the Trailblazer's DEF plus 384 for 1 turn(s).

2.name: The Strong Defend the Weak
2.description: After using the Skill, the DMG taken by all allies reduces by 15% for 1 turn(s).

4.name: Unwavering Gallantry
4.description: Using Enhanced Basic ATK restores the Trailblazer's HP by 5% of their Max HP.

6.name: Action Beats Overthinking
6.description: When the Trailblazer is protected by a Shield at the beginning of the turn, increases their ATK by 15% and regenerates 5 Energy until the action is over.

eidolons.name: Earth-Shaking Resonance
eidolons.description: When the Trailblazer uses their Basic ATK, additionally deals Fire DMG equal to 25% of the Trailblazer's DEF. When the Trailblazer uses their enhanced Basic ATK, additionally deals Fire DMG equal to 50% of the Trailblazer's DEF.

eidolons.name: Time-Defying Tenacity
eidolons.description: The Shield applied to all allies from the Trailblazer's Talent will block extra DMG equal to 2% of the Trailblazer's DEF plus 27.

eidolons.name: Trail-Blazing Blueprint
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Nation-Building Oath
eidolons.description: At the start of the battle, immediately gains 4 stack(s) of Magma Will.

eidolons.name: Spirit-Warming Flame
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: City-Forging Bulwarks
eidolons.description: After the Trailblazer uses enhanced Basic ATK or Ultimate, their DEF increases by 10%. Stacks up to 3 time(s).
